translation: The kneecap bone (膝蓋骨) is the lianhai (連骸), also called the bin bone (臏骨). Its form is round and flat, and it covers the ends of the two bones above and below, the thigh (楗) and the hang (䯒); on its inner side there are sinews connecting it. These sinews pass above over the thigh, reaching to the two flanks, and pass below over the hang bone (胻骨), reaching to the dorsum of the foot.
